scoring: is_deal_request is scored on all posts; the other rows only on posts labeled as deal requests. deal_value_usd matches within ±1%. city ignores case, spacing, periods and commas (no spelling tolerance). missing_fields is exact set equality. notes is free text and NOT scored. Errors never count as correct and stay in the accuracy denominator. A field's hallucination rate is guesses / n_null, the non-errored deal posts whose label for that field is empty; the non-deal posts-with-any rate divides by the non-errored non-deal posts. Brackets are 95% Wilson intervals.
